“你的压岁钱还是留着以后买练习册吧，而且我也没说过要杀豆子，只是过来了解一下情况而已。”
陈万星一听林熙不打算杀豆子，悬着的心顿时松了下来。
至于林熙说的什么练习册，对于刚上小学一年级的他来说，还是太遥远了，陈万星根本体会不到这句话的威力。
此刻的他只知道，林熙既不会杀豆子，也不要他的压岁钱。
而一旁的豆子听到林熙说她不会杀他，也彻底放心了。
汤奶奶和陈爷爷其实也在旁边悄悄地松了一口气。
他们俩都是上了年纪，并且有孙子的人，将心比心，看到和自家孙子年纪差不多大的小孩落到这种地步的时候，其实心里也不太好受。
一开始他们确实是担心孙子会受到伤害，所以才会迫切地想要将这个鬼给解决掉。
但在得知孙子房间里的鬼是个小鬼，年纪这么小就去世了，父母也不在身边了，还没吃的没喝的没玩的，并且对方只是想和孙子交朋友，一块玩耍，完全没有想过伤害任何人之后，他们的想法自然也产生了变化。
此刻的汤奶奶老两口对于豆子只有心疼，再无恐惧和厌恶了。
但听刚刚林熙说的话，似乎鬼不能长期和人生活在一起。
不然的话，就算鬼没有任何害人的心思，也会对活人的身体健康产生影响。
所以，具体该怎么处理豆子，他们还得请教林熙。
“林大师，那豆子这情况，现在该怎么办呢？”
没想到林熙却把问题转丢给了他们。
难不成他们想怎么做，就能怎么做？
按照正常情况来说的话，人和鬼确实是不能朝夕相处的。
因为彼此的阴气和阳气在长期共同相处的情况下，会产生干扰，打破两者之间的平衡。

但如果能有办法维持好这两者间的平衡，既不让鬼被人的阳气所伤，也能保证人不被鬼的阴气所影响。
这种情况下，其实是能做到人鬼共处的。
而要想维持这两者间的平衡也很简单，林熙在他们家里布上相应的符或者阵法来调节一下就行了。
要是汤奶奶他们想让豆子继续留在他家，那林熙就可以帮他们布置阵法。
要是汤奶奶他们想让豆子离开，林熙当然也可以照做。
听完林熙的解释，汤奶奶他们这才恍然大悟。
但具体该怎么办，他们一时间也下不了决心。
其实就他们俩来说，既然林熙都表明了，她能够做到让鬼完全不会影响他们的身体健康，那汤奶奶他们肯定就不担心这一点了。
他们唯一在意的是，豆子想不想留下来，还有孙子还愿不愿意继续让豆子留在家里和他玩。
老两口缓缓将视线看向了两个小孩，然后询问了一下他们的意见。
不出他们所料，豆子和孙子陈万星的决定是一样的，愿意让豆子留下来。
既然豆子自己愿意，而孙子也支持，汤奶奶他们俩当然不会再反对了。
于是就这样，林熙在他们家里布置了相应的阵法，做到让豆子和他们一家子能够在屋子里和平共处，不受影响。
不过，这样的情况也并非永久性的。

> Chapter 889 Stay (Page 1)
"It's better to keep your New Year's money to buy exercise books for later. Besides, I didn't say anything about killing the beans. I just came here to understand the situation."
When Chen Wanxing heard that Lin Xi did not intend to kill Douzi, his heart suddenly relaxed.
As for the exercise book Lin Xi was talking about, it was still too far away for him who had just entered the first grade of elementary school. Chen Wanxing could not understand the power of this sentence at all.
At this moment, he only knew that Lin Xi would neither kill the beans nor ask for his new year's money.
Douzi on the side was completely relieved when she heard Lin Xi say that she would not kill him.
Grandma Tang and Grandpa Chen actually breathed a sigh of relief quietly beside them.
Both of them are elderly and have grandchildren. Comparatively, when they see a child about the same age as their own grandson in this situation, they actually feel uncomfortable.
At first, they were really worried that their grandson would be harmed, so they were eager to get rid of this ghost.
But after learning that the ghost in their grandson's room was a kid who died at such a young age, his parents were no longer around, and he had nothing to eat, drink or play with, and that the other person just wanted to make friends with his grandson and play together without any intention of harming anyone, their thoughts naturally changed.
At this moment, Mrs. Tang and her husband only felt sorry for Douzi, and no longer had any fear or disgust.
But listening to what Lin Xi said just now, it seems that ghosts cannot live with people for a long time.
Otherwise, even if ghosts have no harmful intentions, they will still have an impact on the health of living people.
Therefore, they had to ask Lin Xi for advice on how to deal with the beans.
"Master Lin, what should we do now about Douzi's situation?"
Unexpectedly, Lin Xi turned the question to them.
Is it possible that they can do whatever they want?
Under normal circumstances, humans and ghosts cannot get along day and night.
Because the yin and yang qi of each other will interfere with each other and break the balance between them when they coexist for a long time.
But if there is a way to maintain a good balance between the two, it will not allow ghosts to be harmed by people's yang energy, but also ensure that people are not affected by ghosts' yin energy.
In this case, it is actually possible for humans and ghosts to coexist.
To maintain the balance between the two is also very simple. Lin Xi can just put corresponding talismans or formations in their house to adjust them.
If Grandma Tang and the others want Douzi to stay at his house, then Lin Xi can help them set up the formation.
If Grandma Tang and the others wanted Douzi to leave, Lin Xi could certainly do the same.
After listening to Lin Xi's explanation, Grandma Tang and the others suddenly realized.
But they couldn't make up their minds about what to do specifically.
In fact, as far as the two of them are concerned, since Lin Xi has shown that she can make ghosts not affect their health at all, then Grandma Tang and the others will definitely not worry about this.
The only thing they care about is whether Douzi wants to stay and whether their grandson is willing to continue letting Douzi stay at home and play with him.
The old couple slowly looked at the two children, and then asked for their opinions.
As expected, Douzi and his grandson Chen Wanxing made the same decision and were willing to let Douzi stay.
Since Douzi is willing and his grandson supports it, Granny Tang and the others will certainly not object anymore.
So, Lin Xi arranged corresponding formations in their home so that Douzi and his family could coexist peacefully in the house without being affected.
However, this situation is not permanent.
